# CogniArena Full Technical & Knowledge Specification

> CogniArena is an open, high-precision cognitive assessment telemetry platform.
> Canonical URL: https://cogniarena.com/
> Contact: hello@cogniarena.com

## Technical Architecture & Calibration
Unlike standard web timer benchmarks that rely on primitive JavaScript Date or performance.now() timestamps measured inside event callbacks, CogniArena utilizes hardware refresh rate synchronization.
1. Display Refresh Rate Detection: Measures requestAnimationFrame delta intervals across 30 animation frames and snaps the display to standard industrial refresh rate buckets (60Hz, 75Hz, 90Hz, 120Hz, 144Hz, 165Hz, 240Hz, 280Hz, 360Hz).
2. Double-Nested requestAnimationFrame: Synchronizes timer onset to physical display buffer swap to eliminate browser compositor queue jitter (typically 8ms to 32ms variance on standard web apps).
3. Client-Side Privacy: All session data is stored exclusively in IndexedDB. Zero mandatory cloud accounts. Optional backup via encrypted edge synchronization.

## Assessment Matrix & Experimental Psychology Paradigms

### 1. Reaction & Reflexes
- Visual Reaction Time: Simple reaction time (SRT). Normative population average: ~250ms visual, ~170ms auditory.
- Sound Reaction Time: Auditory reflex testing transduction through the auditory brainstem.
- F1 Start Lights: Anticipatory inhibition testing false alarm suppression.
- Choice Reaction Time: 4-alternative choice reaction latency governed by Hick-Hyman Law: RT = a + b * log2(n).
- Color Go/No-Go: Inhibitory motor control assessing commission error rate.

### 2. Working Memory
- Sequence Memory: Spatial working memory span based on the Corsi Block-Tapping task.
- Number Memory: Forward digit span testing phonological loop capacity (Miller's Law bounds: 7 +/- 2 chunks).
- Visual Pattern: Visuospatial sketchpad capacity testing matrix cell recall.
- Dual N-Back: Working memory updating testing simultaneous visual and auditory tracking (Jaeggi paradigm).
- Verbal Memory: Recognition memory testing word list recall against distractor sets.

### 3. Reasoning & Logic
- Pattern Reasoning: Matrix reasoning testing fluid non-verbal logic (g factor correlate).
- Spatial Orientation: 3D mental rotation based on Shepard & Metzler (1971).

### 4. Focus & Executive Function
- Stroop Test: Selective attention and automatic reading suppression (Anterior Cingulate Cortex activation).
- Trail Making Test (TMT-A & TMT-B): Executive set-shifting and task switching latency.
- Focus Challenge: 5-stage sustained attention test under distraction.
- Multiple Object Tracking (MOT): Visual tracking capacity tracking moving targets among identical distractors.

### 5. Motor Performance
- CPS Test (Click Speed): High-speed clicking rate (clicks per second).
- Aim Trainer: Ballistic motor precision adhering to Fitts's Law: MT = a + b * log2(2D / W).
- Mouse Accuracy: Deceleration control measuring pixel offset error on shrinking targets.
- Flick Trainer: Rapid target acquisition and muscle memory flicking.
- Typing Speed Test: Words per minute (WPM) and character accuracy.

## Non-Clinical Disclaimer
CogniArena is an educational, self-tracking, and cognitive training platform. Its tests are not clinical, psychiatric, medical, or neuropsychological evaluations. They cannot diagnose ADHD, dementia, or cognitive disorders.
